subject: step 26: build the app framework skeleton (API server, Vue app, Tilt, coming-soon)
description: Build the FRAMEWORK + one working example for step 26: a microservice API server under services/api (bootstrap, router, health endpoint, one example endpoint stub), a Vue 3 + Vuetify 3 browser app under apps/web (Vite dev + static GH Pages build), a reusable coming-soon mechanism with mock-data generators, a Tiltfile using local_resource (native processes, no containers), a basic end-to-end example with tests, and a ghcr.io publishing target. Supporting leaf libs: lib/api-contract (shared types), lib/mock-data (lorem + placeholder image generators). NOT the 11 actual pages (steps 30-32), NOT the tilt ci workflow (step 27).
